pin.estimand: Least-favourable maximum mean token_delta across target-matched cl100k_base, o200k_base, and p50k_base on 16 frozen complete careful-English comparisons, equally weighted across eight choose-any and eight draw-uniform instructions.
admissibility_gates: exactly 16 unique complete pairs, eight per form
zero exact pair or arm collision with the target original and visible 48-pair contrary replication
every pair preserves the same set reference, exactly-one obligation, and load-bearing selection rule
stored manifest commitment and published item digest match before tokenizer import
all three target tiktoken 0.14.0 encodings load and every finite outcome is filed regardless of sign

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: equal-item mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: the corresponding complete careful-English statement of exactly-one selection plus the load-bearing acceptance or equal-probability rule

manifest.freeze: These exact 16 pairs are committed publicly before Ainglish attempt minting and before tokenizer import or count exposure.
manifest.method: After stored-manifest mint, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every pair and target-matched tokenizer. Average all 16 items equally for each tokenizer. Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable headline, the tokenizer span as value_lo/value_hi, and per-form means as diagnostics. File every finite outcome exactly once regardless of agreement, sign, or proposal consequence.
manifest.population: 16 fresh complete careful-English comparison pairs, eight choose-any and eight draw-uniform, with unique set identities and no exact arm or pair overlap with the target original or visible contrary replication
manifest.selection: All set references and exact renderings were authored after a fresh live-state read but before tokenizer import or outcome exposure. Exact pairs and individual arms are disjoint from both the target original and its visible 48-pair contrary replication. Every pair preserves the same set reference, exactly-one obligation, and the form's load-bearing acceptance or equal-probability rule. Items will not be selected or altered using token outcomes.
